description:
All the artwork featured in the books and products on our website was created by Michael Dweck, an American photographer, award-winning filmmaker, and visual artist. His work has been showcased in solo exhibitions worldwide and is included in significant international art collections. His images evoke a sense of wanderlust, freedom, and a lust for life, making them both aspirational and provocative. All the artwork featured on the items is copyrighted, and sold exclusively through this store.

IDEAL GIFT 🎁
Our books, posters, t-shirts, and items make great gifts for various occasions, including birthdays, holidays, weddings, anniversaries, graduations, Father's Day, Mother's Day, Valentine's Day, housewarmings, and more. Whether you're looking for gifts for men or women, our collection includes ocean-themed, surf-themed, wall art, beach decor, Montauk-inspired, sporty, aesthetic, artistic, retro, vintage, and photographic items.

WE DONATE🐬 🌊
A portion of proceeds from the sale of all of our products will go to Oceana and Surfrider Foundation – organizations committed to protecting and preserving the world's oceans, waves and beaches.

COMMISSION 💰
We offer an 8% commission on total referral sales when a customer makes a purchase through your affiliate link or uses your coupon code. For products priced $1,500 and above, commission will be 5%. Commission payments will be paid via check or PayPal.

• Product descriptions: 

BOOKS: high quality, clothbound, hardcover coffee-table art books. Limited editions. All printed in Italy or the US. 

POSTERS: art produced in conjunction with Michael Dweck exhibitions around the world.
* Unframed poster
* Paper: heavyweight, premium 175 gsm fine art matte paper (known to be archival, which means it can be stored for a long time without turning yellow)
* Pigmented Archival Inks: bright and intense colors that will not fade when exposed to sunlight regularly
* Printed in the USA
* Available in three sizes:
- 12 in. x 18 in. (30.48 cm x 45.72 cm)
- 20 in. x 30 in. (50.79 cm x 76.19 cm)
- 24 in. x 36 in. (60.96 cm x 91.44 cm)
